summary: Download the gateway OpenAPI spec with curl from https://$AAP_INSTANCE/api/gateway/v1/docs/schema/ as YAML (default) or JSON with ?format=json, authenticating with a personal access token.
questions: How do I download the AAP OpenAPI schema?
How do I get the gateway API spec in JSON?
What is the gateway schema endpoint?

answer_card.title: Download the gateway OpenAPI spec
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
curl -o gateway_openapi_spec.yaml "https://$AAP_INSTANCE/api/gateway/v1/docs/schema/"
curl -o gateway_openapi_spec.json "https://$AAP_INSTANCE/api/gateway/v1/docs/schema/?format=json"
```
Token authentication with a personal access token is recommended for programmatic access.
